rules.statement: DATA_OE[i] is set to data bit i where mask bit i is 1 and every other DATA_OE bit is left unchanged, as for DATA_OUT.
Bits 15:0 of the read return the corresponding half of DATA_OUT or DATA_OE; bits 31:16 of MASKED_OUT_* read 0.

rules.condition: after reset and until written; o_gpio and o_gpio_en also while rst_ni = 0
rules.statement: DIRECT_OUT, DIRECT_OE, MASKED_*, INTR_CTRL_EN_*, CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER, PER_PIN_OE_i, PER_PIN_INTR_CTRL_i and PER_PIN_IO_i.data_out read 0; o_gpio and o_gpio_en are 0.

rules.condition: INTR_ENABLE[i] = 1 and a configured event occurs
rules.statement: A configured event sets INTR_STATE[i].
o_intr_gpio[i] stays 0.

rules.condition: level condition still holds after write of 1 to INTR_STATE[i]
rules.statement: INTR_STATE[i] reads 1 and o_intr_gpio[i] with INTR_ENABLE[i] = 1 is 1 again within 4 cycles after the write response.

rules.condition: CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER[i] = 1 and new i_gpio[i] value held at most 12 cycles
rules.statement: The new value never appears in DATA_IN[i] and creates no interrupt event.

rules.condition: CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER[i] = 1 and new i_gpio[i] value held at least 24 cycles
rules.statement: The new value appears in DATA_IN[i] no later than 24 cycles after the change.

rules.condition: after a write that changes CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER[i], for 24 cycles
rules.statement: Tests keep i_gpio[i] constant; DATA_IN[i] and interrupt events are not checked in this window.
Tests keep i_strap_en = 0 while rst_ni = 0 and at least 4 cycles after release, raise it once, and keep i_gpio constant from 24 cycles before to 8 cycles after the rising edge.

rules.condition: GpioAsHwStrapsEn = 1, within 4 cycles after the i_strap_en rising edge
rules.statement: HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN_VALID reads 1, o_straps_valid = 1, and HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN and o_straps_data equal the sampled i_gpio value.

rules.condition: GpioAsHwStrapsEn = 1, before the i_strap_en rising edge
rules.statement: Both valid indications are 0.

rules.condition: GpioAsHwStrapsEn = 1, after strap sampling until reset
rules.statement: Later changes of i_gpio or i_strap_en change neither the valid indications nor the strap data.
HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN reads 0 at all times.
Tests write 0x8000_0001 to keep regwen at 1 and do not use the combined write 0x0000_0001.

rules.condition: after a write with bit 31 = 0 sets regwen to 0, until reset
rules.statement: A write of 0x8000_0001 completes with d_error = 0, triggers no alert, and regwen still reads 0.

rules.condition: one write of 1 to fatal_fault, no other alert cause and no other such write within 32 cycles
rules.statement: Exactly one o_alert pulse occurs, no later than 16 cycles after the write response.
ALERT_TEST reads 0x8000_0000.
Tests do not use a write with i_a_instr = 1; d_error of a request with i_a_instr = 1 is not checked.

rules.condition: request to an unmapped offset in 0x000..0x3FF
rules.statement: The response has d_error = 1 and no register changes.
Requests at offset 0x400 and above are not used.

rules.condition: aligned byte write (a_size 0, mask 0001) to INTR_*, DIRECT_*, MASKED_*, INTR_CTRL_EN_*, CTRL_EN_INPUT_FILTER or PER_PIN_IO_i
rules.statement: The write returns d_error = 1 and changes nothing.

rules.condition: aligned byte write (a_size 0, mask 0001) to PER_PIN_OE_i or PER_PIN_INTR_CTRL_i
rules.statement: The write completes with d_error = 0 and has the effect of the write.
The write succeeds.
The read returns the full register.
The test bench matches responses by d_source, uses a distinct a_source per outstanding request, and does not assume o_a_ready = 1.
d_source echoes a_source, d_size echoes a_size, and d_opcode is AccessAckData for Get and AccessAck for PutFullData and PutPartialData.
d_error = 1.
d_data is checked.
The test bench keeps i_a_valid = 0 while rst_ni = 0 and in the first cycle after release.
o_d_valid, o_alert, o_alert_integ_fail, o_intr_gpio, o_gpio and o_gpio_en are 0.
The pending response is discarded.
o_d_intg_err and o_alert_integ_fail are 0 in every cycle.
o_alert pulses no later than 16 cycles later and then at least once in every 32 cycles until rst_ni is asserted.

rules.condition: filter off, i_gpio[i] change held at least 8 cycles
rules.statement: DATA_IN[i] shows the change no later than 4 cycles after the first rising edge after the change, for both values of GpioAsyncOn.
INTR_STATE[i] is set no later than 4 cycles after it.

rules.condition: except in the 2 cycles after INTR_STATE or INTR_ENABLE changes
rules.statement: o_intr_gpio[i] equals INTR_STATE[i] AND INTR_ENABLE[i].

rules.condition: after a write that changed DATA_OUT or DATA_OE
rules.statement: o_gpio and o_gpio_en equal DATA_OUT and DATA_OE no later than 2 cycles after the write response.

rules.condition: write to a ro register or field (DATA_IN, HW_STRAPS_*, PER_PIN_IO_i.data_in)
rules.statement: The register or field is left unchanged.

rules.condition: read of a wo field (INTR_TEST, MASKED_OUT_* mask, ALERT_TEST.fatal_fault)
rules.statement: The read returns 0.
Reserved bits read 0 and writes to them have no effect.
INTR_CTRL_EN_LVLLOW and INTR_CTRL_EN_LVLHIGH enable level detection, not edge detection.
DATA_IN[i] follows i_gpio[i], not o_gpio[i].
Tests drive i_a_param = 0.
